tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Find natural stone suppliers, factories, exporters, quarry owners and fabricators listed on Stone Buy and Sell. Returns profile URLs, location, company type, categories, listed product count and verification badges.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Full public profile of one supplier: description, categories, certifications, export markets, departure ports, minimum order, up to 25 listings and any quarries it operates.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find product listings (slabs, tiles, blocks, countertops, machinery and more) with origin, color, finish, size and supplier. Prices appear only where the supplier made them public.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details of one listing: description, specifications, sizes, quantity, lead time, departure port, images and supplier.

tools.name: search_quarries
tools.description: Search the quarry database by stone and country: where a stone is quarried, quarry location and stones, and the operating company when it has a public profile.

tools.name: get_quarry
tools.description: Details of one quarry: location, stones, description, production and operator.

tools.name: list_reference_data
tools.description: Valid categories, stone types (with guide links), colors, finishes, company types, and supplier countries with supplier counts.

tools.name: find_company_listing
tools.description: For an agent working for a stone company: check whether the company is listed on Stone Buy and Sell, whether its profile is claimed, and how to claim it for free, get its catalog loaded for free and connect an agent to manage its profile and products.
